title: Study of Genes in Relation to Seasonal Affective Disorder and Major Depressive Disorder
brief_summary: The investigators are looking for volunteers who have a history of Major Depressive Disorder, the Winter Blues, or Seasonal Affective Disorder or healthy volunteers who do not have a history of these disorders for a research study on genetics.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* SAD or MDD
* healthy control

Exclusion Criteria:

* drug or alcohol dependence
* Bipolar Disorder
